# SC-01: Ten September purchase orders reach the order sheet

## Steps
1. Forward the 10 purchase orders named below to the orders mailbox, one email each.
2. Wait 15 minutes, then open the order sheet copy.
3. Check each order's lines against its purchase order.

## Expected result
Each order's lines appear in the order sheet within 15 minutes, with the product codes in the LC-nnnn form, and nobody retypes them. All 10 arrive with every line correct (10 cases).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: the client's September set of purchase orders (real data: client decision, operations manager, 2027-01-04); records: the first 10 order numbers in the set; count: 10; fields: order number, customer, product code, quantity.
